name: Aqua-Terrarium 60x45x40x45
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 60x45x40 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 45 cm.
imageAlt: Aqua-Terrarium 60x45x40x45 glass terrarium with water section - NS Reptiles

description.html: What sets this one apart from the other 60 cm long aqua-terrariums is its width: the floor is 60x45 cm, or 2700 cm², compared with 2100 cm² on the 35 cm wide model. The enclosure is 40 cm high and the total volume is about 108 liters. The wider floor gives a turtle room to turn around in the water without knocking its shell against the glass.

The lower 40 cm profile makes it easier to reach in by hand for cleaning and feeding. The land section is placed along one side wall, under the heat lamp, while the rest of the floor stays under water. Because of the 45 cm width it needs a cabinet or table of that depth, with a flat top that carries the weight of the water.
A 45 cm wide floor is chosen by owners of the following animals:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: For this model we agree the layout of water and land when you order, so tell us which species you keep and how big it is. On request we also change the length, width or height. The film for the outer sides is chosen from 34 patterns, and the build takes between 7 and 14 days. The finished aqua-terrarium arrives by courier, so prepare its place before delivery.
